subject: Renewal & Expansion pricing follow-up - volume step-ups / blended rates / new routes
messages:
From: Sarah Chen <sarah@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion pricing follow-up - volume step-ups / blended rates / new routes

Thanks Marissa - great call this morning. Quick recap from our side: Acme plans to renew the core search & triage route (currently 5M tokens/mo) and pilot 2 new model routes for clinical summarization (estimated 7M tokens/mo) and coding-assist (estimated 3M tokens/mo) starting in Q3.

Budget-wise, our finance team is targeting ~$8k-$12k/month for the renewal line item, but we might have additional headroom for the pilots if unit economics look favorable. We discussed blended rates and step-up tiers on the call - can you send a proposal with:
- Blended rate for combined 15M tokens/mo
- Step-up pricing for 5M -> 15M+ buckets and an example blended $/1M tokens
- Impact of adding two separate routes/models on monthly committing vs. per-use pricing

Also copying procurement for contract questions.

Thanks,
Sarah
Director of Product
Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion pricing follow-up - volume step-ups / blended rates / new routes

Hi Sarah - thanks for the clear recap and for looping procurement. Helpful details. I captured the key asks below and will attach a pricing proposal (v2) with examples. High level answers inline first: 

- Blended rate for combined 15M tokens/mo: we can offer a blended rate of $3.50 per 1k tokens (equivalent to $3,500 per 1M tokens) as a starting point for a committed 12-month renewal across the three routes, with a blended credit structure applied for the pilot months.
- Step-up pricing: we propose tiered unit economics with step-ups at 5M, 15M, and 30M:
  • 0-5M: $4.20 / 1k ($4,200 / 1M)
  • 5M-15M: $3.50 / 1k ($3,500 / 1M)
  • 15M-30M: $2.75 / 1k ($2,750 / 1M)
  Example blended for 15M: ((5M*$4.2)+(10M*$3.5))/15M = $3.73 / 1k (~$3,730 / 1M) - but we can tighten to $3.5k / 1M with a contractual step-up credit to hit your budget.
- Adding new routes/models: if you commit the pilot routes into the renewal (i.e., include them in the committed 15M), we can provide a blended rate and remove per-route setup fees. If pilots remain pay-as-you-go and exceed threshold, they'll be billed at the overage tiers above.

Next steps I recommend:
1) I'll send a formal pricing proposal (attached) that includes two scenarios: (A) renewal + pilots committed into the 15M blended bucket, and (B) renewal committed + pilots pay-as-you-go with overage protection.
2) Procurement to confirm target budget range and any PO/contracting timelines.
3) If Scenario A looks good, we'll draft the renewal SOW and align on start date (target 2026-07-01) & billing cadence.

I attached a versioned proposal and a usage forecast spreadsheet with the numbers we discussed. Happy to hop on another quick call tomorrow to walk procurement through the two scenarios.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-pricing-proposal-v2.pdf
Attachment: acme-usage-forecast-q2.csv

From: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Chen <sarah@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-20T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion pricing follow-up - volume step-ups / blended rates / new routes

Marissa - thanks for the prompt follow up and the scenarios. A couple quick procurement constraints from our side:
- We need any renewal commitment >$50k/yr to flow through our standard Master Agreement and procurement review (estimated 2-3 weeks).
- Prefer net-30 billing and a single invoice for committed capacity.
- For pilots, we prefer to keep them outside the committed capacity until proven; if there's a clear path to commit within the quarter, we can expedite approval.

Can you include a note on the proposal about contract flow and the expected timeline for underwriting? Also confirm whether you support a single invoice for committed capacity and separate billing for pilots.

Regards,
Procurement Team
Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>, Sarah Chen <sarah@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-21T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion pricing follow-up - volume step-ups / blended rates / new routes

Hi - noted, thanks. Confirmations for procurement: 
- We support net-30 billing and can issue a single invoice for committed capacity. Pilots can be billed separately as pay-as-you-go line items (monthly) unless you convert them into the committed SOW.
- I added a procurement flow note in the proposal and the expected 2-3 week review for >$50k/yr commitments. If legal requires changes, we typically track them in DocuSign and can provide a clean SOW to accelerate underwriting.

Michael - looping you for quick pricing ops check: is there flexibility to tighten the blended 15M example to hit Acme's upper budget target (~$12k/mo) without expanding term length? If we can offer a promotional credit or step-up credit, what's the delta?

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>, Sarah Chen <sarah@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T16:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion pricing follow-up - volume step-ups / blended rates / new routes

Marissa / team - quick ops response after modeling the numbers: we can tighten the blended 15M to $2,750 / 1M tokens (i.e., $2.75 / 1k) if Acme commits to a 12-month term and we apply a one-time step-up credit that phases over the first three billing cycles. That gets the committed cost to roughly $41.25k/month (for 15M tokens) but with the credit it will net to ~$33k-$36k/month in the first quarter which aligns with the ~$8k-$12k/month per-line budget only if Acme splits billing by route - otherwise the total committed spend will be higher.

Tradeoffs / notes:
- To hit $12k/month total you'd need a much lower unit price or a smaller committed volume (~3.5M tokens), which changes coverage for the pilots.
- We can structure pilot protection: if pilots exceed their estimated volumes, they auto-transition into overage tiers and we cap month-over-month increases during the pilot period.

I'll update the attached pricing doc with the step-up credit scenario and a clear invoice/billing example showing single invoice for committed capacity + separate pilot line items.

Cheers,
Michael Grant
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-pricing-proposal-v2.pdf (updated)
